function: Learned mixed-action MPDQN chooses edge-server VDT placement plus a sensing/communication time split for AoI utility: above the physical layer (p. 9).
notes: Excluded as above_phy. p. 9: "Each agent selects its action from the action space A, which includes the communication and sensing times, and the VDT placement strategy for the vehicle." The placement of vehicle digital twins on edge servers is an edge computing decision, and the authors call the slot ratio "time scheduling within each frame structure" (p. 3). The OFDM waveform (p. 4) and the transmit power of 23 dBm (Table II, p. 11) are fixed, so no beam, waveform, power, channel or RIS function is learned. If a reviewer counted the slot ratio as a physical-layer ISAC resource, the next applicable code would be system: channels are scalar gains (p. 5) with no antenna array or RIS. Tables I-III were read from page images (pp. 4, 11).
